Gideon, the corrected Vantorre Group seat count you posted here on 1 Jul is **280**. You posted it at 09:19, replacing the 300 from your 09:14 update. The 280 is the production roster figure as of that day; the 300 included sandbox logins from the May rollout.

I replied in your thread. My first reply said Ruth's QBR note was in that thread, but it was a channel message at 09:21, so I posted a correction there too.
